summary: Examples read /proc/mounts with slurp and decode it with b64decode, read it without armor, and slurp a pid file ad hoc then decode with base64 -d.
questions: How do I decode slurp content in a debug message?
How do I read a pid file from a remote host?

answer_card.title: slurp examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.slurp: {src: /proc/mounts}
  register: mounts
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ mounts['content'] | b64decode }}"
- ansible.builtin.slurp: {src: /proc/mounts, armor: false}
```
Ad hoc: `ansible host -m ansible.builtin.slurp -a 'src=/var/run/sshd.pid'`.
